## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the before/after behavior and link the relevant issue if one exists.

## Validation

List exact commands/results and skipped checks. Include browser evidence for visible changes. Label synthetic data explicitly.

## Safety and rights

- [ ] No secrets, personal data, databases, weights or private recordings.
- [ ] Upstream notices retained; I have the right to submit this contribution.
- [ ] Relevant regression tests cover changed trust boundaries or data writes.
- [ ] I read CONTRIBUTING.md and signed off commits under DCO 1.1.
